svg.title: Archiving and handover: materials to acceptance
svg.desc: Ensure the recipient can locate, open and verify materials, with clear retention and access responsibilities. Solid arrows move downwards, gold diamonds are decisions, and dashed lines return after correction.Submit degree materials and hand over research records separately. Keep public copies apart from controlled originals. Transfer access through organization-approved procedures; do not share personal account passwords.
